summary: Verified LSCEO Grant submission fix end-to-end. Backend proxy /api/lsceo-grant/submit returns HTTP 200 with {ok:false, error:'Google Apps Script returned Access Denied...'}. Frontend now POSTs to backend proxy (not script.google.com directly), stays on section2 on error, shows the exact server error in [data-testid='grant-error'], and re-enables the submit button. Ineligible branch correctly routes to 'Thanks for your interest' with a Return to Grant page button, WITHOUT any backend POST. REACT_APP_LSCEO_GRANT_SHEETS_URL is no longer referenced from any frontend source (only a stale docstring comment mentions the name).
action_items: User must redeploy the Google Apps Script Web App with 'Who has access: Anyone' — the current deployment still returns 403 Access Denied. This is expected and outside code fix scope, but until done, no submissions will land in Google Sheets.

Optional cleanup: line 11 of /app/frontend/src/signup-forms/LSCEOGrantForm.js still contains a docstring comment referencing 'REACT_APP_LSCEO_GRANT_SHEETS_URL' — no functional impact, but update the comment to say the backend proxy is used.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend endpoint is well-designed: swallows network/4xx into HTTP 200 JSON so Cloudflare can't intercept, and detects both status>=400 and Access Denied/You need access substrings.
Frontend correctly checks response.ok && body.ok===true and surfaces body.error to the user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google Apps Script deployment (LSCEO_GRANT_SHEETS_URL in /app/backend/.env) still returns 403 Access Denied — this is a user-side deployment permission issue, not a code bug. The fix under test only ensures the app now correctly detects and surfaces the failure rather than silently claiming success. Verified via curl + Playwright: form stays on section2, red error strip shown with 'Access Denied' text, no success screen, submit re-enabled. Ineligible branch unchanged and does not hit backend.
